text.p: UK-based distribution group Inchcape Plc said on Thursday it had appointed Les Cullen as group finance director.
Cullen joins Inchcape's board on April 21 and will succeed Rod O'Donoghue on July 1. He joins Inchcape from Goodman Fielder, Australasia's largest food company, where he was chief financial officer.

O'Donoghue has been finance director since 1986 and will remain as an executive director, reporting to Philip Cushing, Inchcape chief executive, to ensure a smooth transition. He will maintain responsibility for information technology and will also work on other operational assignments until his retirement in June 1998, Inchcape said in a statement.

Inchcape also announced that, at his request, Paul Cheng, a non-executive director of Inchcape plc, stand down from the board at Inchcape's annual meeting on May 22. At the same time, Cheng will retire from his position as chairman of Inchcape Pacific, the company's regional arm for Greater China based in Hong Kong.
